metadata.article_title: Pawnee not to retain for debt or promise other than that for which goods pledged. Presumption in case of subsequent advances.

article.title: Pawnee not to retain for debt or promise other than that for which goods pledged. Presumption in case of subsequent advances.
article.content:
174Pawnee not to retain for debt or promise other than that for which goods pledged. Presumption in case of subsequent advances.

Section 174  ·  Chapter IX  ·  Bailments of Pledges  ·  page 42 of the Act
The pawnee shall not, in the absence of a contract to that effect, retain the goods pledged for any debt or promise other than the debt or promise for which they are pledged; but such contract, in the absence of anything to the contrary, shall be presumed in regard to subsequent advances made by the pawnee.
